title: Patch: the game log says a unit got −5/+0 when a card lowers its stats, instead of "gained +-5/+0"
thread:
**Issue #3865 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3865: Patch: the game log says a unit got −5/+0 when a card lowers its stats, instead of "gained +-5/+0"
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a card lowers a unit's Attack or Health, the game log calls the loss a gain and prints a garbled number. Cast Secure System with a 5-Attack unit on the board and the log reads "Arg Arg Defender gained +-5/+0". A Mid Loser that loses its coin flip reads "Mid Loser gained +-2/+-2", and every unit Astrophage steals from gets the same kind of line. The board's effect already plays these as a curse, so the picture and the words disagree. Once this is built, a loss reads "got −5/+0" with a real minus sign, as the card text prints it, in English and in Chinese. Every ordinary gain reads exactly as it does today. Any player who reads the log during a game or a replay will notice.

## Why

- The engine's `buffed` event carries the signed change it applied. `crates/engine/src/effects/buff.rs:84-90` pushes `attack` and `health` as they were given, negative numbers included (`crates/engine/src/wire/events.rs:580-584`).
- The log has one sentence for that event, with the plus signs written into the template: `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs:609-616`, `"{target} gained +{attack}/+{health}"`. A number goes in through plain `to_string()` (`crates/shared/src/log/say.rs`, `impl From<i32> for Part`), so −5 prints as `+-5`. The Chinese entry has the same plus signs (`crates/shared/data/zh-CN.json:266`).
- Three shipped cards send a negative `buffed` event to a unit the viewer can see:
  - S #118 Secure System gives each Unit minus its Attack (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c118_secure_system.rs:22-27`, §8.10 row 118).
  - S+ #86 Astrophage gives each Unit it steals from `-attack`/`-health` (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c086_astrophage.rs:57-61`).
  - C+ #19.3 Mid Loser gives itself `-tails/-tails` on tails (`crates/cards/src/scripts/classic_plus/c019_3_mid_loser.rs:41`).
- The client's effects already read the sign: `apps/web/src/fx/cues.ts:673-680` and `apps/web/src/fx/motifs/life.ts:123` play `curse` when the net change is below 0. Only the words are wrong.
- No test catches it. Every `buffed` event in `crates/shared/tests/log.rs` (lines 143, 395 and 439) and in `apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx:660` is positive.

## Proposal

- In the `GameEvent::Buffed` arm of `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs`, keep `"{target} gained +{attack}/+{health}"` when neither number is below 0. Every gain then reads as it does today, and its tests stand.
- When either number is below 0, write a new sentence, `"{target} got {attack}/{health}"`, with each number signed: `+N` for 0 and up, and `−N` below 0, using U+2212. That is the `MINUS` that `crates/shared/src/face/tuning.rs:18` already defines and that card text prints. Secure System's line becomes "… got −5/+0", Mid Loser's "… got −2/−2", and a mixed change "… got +2/−1".
- Put the signer with the log's number parts in `say.rs` or `lines.rs`. `face/tuning.rs`'s private `signed` doesn't fit as it is, because it writes 0 as `−0`.
- Add the new sentence's `zh-CN.json` entry. The dictionary test in `crates/shared/tests/log.rs` (`sentences()`, around line 1463) already fails on any English log line that has no Chinese entry.
- Leave the hidden-card line (`"A hidden card was buffed"`, R177) as it is.
- Rejected: "lost 5 Attack" wording. It needs separate sentences for Attack alone, Health alone, both and mixed signs, all to say what one signed pair already says.
- Rejected: signed numbers on every buff line. That rewrites a line players already know, and the tests that pin it, for no gain.

## Where it lands

- `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs`: the `Buffed` arm, lines 599-618.
- `crates/shared/src/log/say.rs`: the signer, beside the log's number parts.
- `crates/shared/data/zh-CN.json`: the new sentence.
- `crates/shared/tests/log.rs`: the new cases. Optionally also a case in `apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx`.
- No spec change. SPEC §10.10 (client rendering) does not set the log's wording, and wording is not a rules decision, so no ruling is needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A `buffed` event of −5/0 on a unit the viewer can read logs "{name} got −5/+0" with U+2212, and one of −2/−2 logs "{name} got −2/−2". Both are tested in `crates/shared/tests/log.rs`.
- [ ] A mixed change of +2/−1 logs "{name} got +2/−1".
- [ ] A gain of +2/+1 or +0/+3 logs exactly as today ("gained +2/+1", "gained +0/+3"), and the existing log tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] No line the log writes contains `+-` or `+−`.
- [ ] The new sentence has a `zh-CN.json` entry, the dictionary test passes, and a Chinese case pins the translated line.
- [ ] A hidden card's buff still logs "A hidden card was buffed".
- [ ] One test sends a real negative buff from a card through the engine to the log line, for example Secure System on a unit with Attack, or Mid Loser on tails. That pins the event's sign and the line's wording together.
- [ ] These pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-shared`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-shared --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/Log.test.tsx`.

## Size and risks

Small, `difficulty:medium`: one match arm, a few lines of number formatting, one dictionary entry and a handful of tests, in under 10 files. Nothing changes in the rules, the engine, the AI or the wire format. The one risk is the Chinese wording. The bot writes it from the existing entry's pattern, and a native reader may want to adjust it later.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43453044902)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

When a `buffed` event lowers a unit's Attack or Health, the log reads `{name} got −5/+0`, with U+2212 and a `+` on any number that is 0 or above. Every non-negative buff still reads `{name} gained +A/+H`, and the hidden-card line is untouched. The new sentence has a `zh-CN.json` entry. Tests cover English, mixed signs, Chinese, the dictionary, and a real negative buff (Secure System) taken through the engine to the log line.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/shared/src/log/say.rs` | `change` Add `pub fn signed(n: i32) -> String`, next to the `From<i32>` impl. |
| `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs` | `change` In the `GameEvent::Buffed` arm (about lines 599-618), keep the gain sentence and add a "got" sentence for a negative number. |
| `crates/shared/data/zh-CN.json` | `change` Add the Chinese entry for the new sentence, right after line 266. |
| `crates/shared/tests/log.rs` | `change` Add the new tests, after the first test (line 139-149). |

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `apps/web`, `spec/`, or `crates/shared/src/face/tuning.rs`. The face module's private `signed` stays as it is.

No spec section or ruling is involved. The log's wording is not a rules decision (SPEC §10.10 does not fix it), so there is no `spec/rulings` note, no `spec/pending` file and no patches fragment. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

## Steps

1. **`crates/shared/src/log/say.rs`:** add the signer after the `From<usize>` impl (around line 38):
   ```rust
   /// A change as a signed number for the log: "+2", "+0", "−5" (U+2212, the minus a card's text prints).
   pub fn signed(number: i32) -> String {
       if number < 0 {
           format!("{MINUS}{}", number.unsigned_abs())
       } else {
           format!("+{number}")
       }
   }
   ```
   Add `use crate::face::tuning::MINUS;` to the imports at the top. `MINUS` is `pub const &str` in `face/tuning.rs:18`, and `face::tuning` is a `pub mod`. 0 prints as `+0`.

2. **`crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs`:**
   - Add `signed` to the import `use super::say::{Part, capitalised, capitalised_spans, plain_words, sentence};`.
   - In the `Buffed` arm's else-branch, split on `*attack < 0 || *health < 0`. The negative branch must keep the `s(` call with a string literal that sits alone on its own line, the same layout as the existing one. The dictionary test scans for that layout.
   ```rust
   } else if *attack < 0 || *health < 0 {
       s(
           "{target} got {attack}/{health}",
           vec![
               p("target", target(instance_id)),
               p("attack", signed(*attack)),
               p("health", signed(*health)),
           ],
       )
   } else {
       s("{target} gained +{attack}/+{health}", /* unchanged */)
   }
   ```
   Keep the existing gain `s(...)` call exactly as it is. Keep the R177 comment and add a note that a negative change is signed (U+2212) so it never prints `+-`.

3. **`crates/shared/data/zh-CN.json`:** insert after line 266 (`"{target} gained +{attack}/+{health}"`):
   ```json
   "{target} got {attack}/{health}": "{target}的属性变化：{attack}/{health}",
   ```
   The numbers keep their `+` or `−`. Keep the file's two-space indent and a trailing comma. Check that the file is still valid JSON and that the key is not already present.

4. **`crates/shared/tests/log.rs`:** add the tests below, using the file's `board`, `english`, `said`, `name_of`, `chinese_name_of`, `ready` and `Locale` helpers.

## Tests

All in `crates/shared/tests/log.rs`, after the first test in the file. `u1` is p1's `core-032` on the `board()` helper, so `name_of("core-032")` is its name.

- `a_buff_that_lowers_a_units_stats_says_it_got_the_signed_change_with_a_real_minus`: `board(json!([...]))` with these `buffed` events on `u1`:
  - `attack: -5, health: 0`
  - `attack: -2, health: -2`
  - `attack: 2, health: -1`
  - `attack: 0, health: -3`

  It asserts `english(&view)` equals, in order, `"{n} got −5/+0"`, `"{n} got −2/−2"`, `"{n} got +2/−1"` and `"{n} got +0/−3"`, with `n = name_of("core-032")` and `−` written as U+2212. It also asserts that the joined lines contain neither `"+-"` nor `"+−"`.
- `a_gain_still_reads_gained_with_plus_signs_and_a_hidden_negative_buff_stays_hidden`: events `{u1, 2, 1}`, `{u1, 0, 3}` and `{"hidden", 0, 0}`. It expects `gained +2/+1`, `gained +0/+3` and `A hidden card was buffed`. This pins the unchanged lines and the R177 line.
- `a_reader_of_chinese_reads_a_loss_in_chinese`: `said(&board(json!([{ "type": "buffed", "instanceId": "u1", "attack": -5, "health": 0 }])), Locale::ZhCn)` equals `[format!("{}的属性变化：−5/+0", chinese_name_of("core-032"))]`. The Chinese name comes from `chinese_name_of`, as in the existing test at line 414-427.
- `a_real_secure_system_sends_a_negative_buff_through_the_engine_to_the_log`. Copy the setup pattern of `crates/shared/tests/duel.rs` (`jackioh_cards::register_all();` then `jackioh_engine::testkit::scenario`). Imports as in `duel.rs:1479`: `use jackioh_engine::testkit::{json, scenario};` and `use jackioh_engine::wire::PlayerId;` (check the exact paths with the compiler).
  1. Build `scenario(json!({ "seed": "r3865", "active": "p1", "p1": { "hand": ["stinkyscape-118"], "field": ["core-011"], "mana": 10, "library": ["core-005","core-005","core-005","core-005"] }, "p2": { "hand": ["core-005"], "library": ["core-005","core-005","core-005","core-005"] } }))`. This copies `secure_board` in `c118_secure_system.rs`, whose shape is p1 `hand`/`field`/`mana`/`library` and p2 `hand`/`field`/`library`. If `core-011` has 0 Attack, pick another vanilla unit.
  2. `let unit = s.unit_at(P1, 1)`, then `let attack = s.stats(&unit).attack` (check the `CardRef` argument form against `scenario.rs:1502`), then `assert!(attack > 0)`.
  3. `s.play("stinkyscape-118", json!({}));`
  4. `let lines = english(&s.view(P1));` and assert `lines.contains(&format!("{} got −{attack}/+0", name_of("core-011")))`. The view's `events` hold the newest action's events (`recent_events`), so the buff is in it.
  5. Assert no line contains `"+-"`.

  This pins the event's sign and the line's wording together. If the unit's name does not match because of the radiant or position state, read the name from `s.view(P1).you.units` instead.
- The existing dictionary test (`sentences()` near line 1463) must pass unchanged. It fails if the new sentence has no `zh-CN.json` entry.

Commands, in this order:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-shared --test log
cargo test -p jackioh-shared
cargo clippy -p jackioh-shared --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/Log.test.tsx
```
The web test runs the log through the WebAssembly build (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`). Do not edit `Log.test.tsx`.

## Done when

- [ ] −5/0 logs "got −5/+0", −2/−2 logs "got −2/−2", +2/−1 logs "got +2/−1", and every one uses U+2212.
- [ ] Gains still read "gained +A/+H", and the hidden buff still reads "A hidden card was buffed".
- [ ] No log line contains `+-` or `+−`.
- [ ] The `zh-CN.json` entry exists, the Chinese case passes and the dictionary test passes.
- [ ] The Secure System engine-to-log test passes.
- [ ] The existing log tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-shared`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-shared --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and the `Log.test.tsx` vitest run all pass.
- [ ] No new `#[allow]`.
- [ ] `git status` shows only the four files above.

## Risks

- **Dictionary scan:** `sentences()` finds a sentence only if its literal is the first argument of `s(` or on a line of its own. Keep the new literal on its own line inside `s(`.
- **Web side:** the web's log reads these lines through the wasm `log` body, so the Chinese entry is the only web-visible part. The existing positive-buff web test is unaffected, because gains are unchanged.
- **Hidden information:** the hidden branch (`hidden(instance_id)`) is evaluated first, so a sentinel buff of 0/0 never reaches the new branch.
- **No wire or engine change:** `apps/web/src/wire` stays clean, so the cargo-tests step's `git status` check passes.
- **Chinese wording:** this is the bot's choice and a native reader may adjust it later.

## Open questions

None. Decision recorded: signed numbers only on the new "got" sentence; the existing gain sentence and "lost 5 Attack" wording are rejected, as in the issue.
````
